extraction.Name: Grace Riley
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to C. T. Torrison for $1000, Nov. 1918. Sold same to Mrs. Mary Voltz about May 1919. Purchaser assumed mortgage at time of sale.
extraction.NOTES: Deposition made by Mrs. Grace Riley to questionnaire submitted by E. W. Jermark, Superintendent, Pine Ridge Agency. Patent was sent by registered mail and card receipted about Aug. 1918; she had not requested patent. Five children dependent upon her for support. Notarized November 17, 1928 at Newell, Butte County, S.D. by notary C.D. Sanders. | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
